biography: Rodrigo Ricciardi, hailing from the sun-drenched favelas of Rio de Janeiro, wasn't born into racing royalty. His journey began with makeshift go-karts crafted from scrap metal, tearing through the narrow, winding streets of his neighborhood. A local mechanic, recognizing Rodrigo's raw talent and fearless aggression, sponsored him in a regional karting championship. His unpredictable nature shone early – capable of blistering pace one moment, then a costly error the next. A defining moment came at Interlagos during a national karting final. Despite starting at the back after a qualifying mishap, Rodrigo clawed his way to the front, overtaking on the last corner with a daring move that left the crowd breathless, securing his first major victory. This earned him a spot in the Passat Classic B team, where he continues to showcase his inconsistent brilliance, often battling against the limitations of his equipment but always injecting a dose of Brazilian flair into every race.
drivingStyle: Rodrigo's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He attacks corners with relentless aggression, often pushing the limits of grip and flirting with disaster. Tire management is not his forte; he prefers to extract maximum performance early in a stint, often sacrificing longevity for immediate gains. Under pressure, he can either elevate his game to a new level, pulling off stunning overtakes, or crack under the strain, making uncharacteristic mistakes. It's this unpredictability that both thrills and frustrates his team.

rivalries.name: Enzo Ferreira
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days. Enzo, known for his calculated and consistent approach, often clashed with Rodrigo's aggressive style, leading to numerous on-track collisions and off-track spats.

rivalries.name: Isabela Silva
rivalries.reason: A more recent rivalry, fueled by a controversial incident at Curitiba where Rodrigo allegedly blocked Isabela during qualifying, preventing her from securing a better grid position. She accused him of deliberately sabotaging her race, and the feud has been simmering ever since.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Vargas
rivalries.reason: Vargas, a veteran driver known for his defensive tactics, often finds himself in Rodrigo's crosshairs. Rodrigo views Vargas as an obstacle to his progress, and their battles on the track are often characterized by close calls and aggressive maneuvers.

quirks: Always wears the same faded yellow t-shirt under his racing suit, claiming it brings him good luck.
Listens to a specific samba song by Beth Carvalho before every race to calm his nerves.
Refuses to shake hands with anyone before the start of a race, believing it will jinx his chances.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about perfection; it's about embracing the chaos and finding the edge. If you're not on the edge, you're taking up too much space."
careerHighlight: Winning the Interlagos Karting Final in 2016, a last-lap overtake that cemented his reputation as a fearless competitor and secured his future in motorsport.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the Santa Cruz Classic in 2021 due to a reckless attempt to overtake a backmarker, costing his team valuable championship points.
